name: ConsentRecord
description: Records patient consent for various policies (Terms of Use, Privacy Policy) and data access rights.

attributes.name: patientId
attributes.description: Owning patient's User ID. Set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning patient or an admin may update/delete.

attributes.name: consentType
attributes.description: The type of policy or data usage the patient is consenting to.

attributes.name: consentDate
attributes.description: The date and time when consent was granted or updated.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version of the policy or terms to which consent was given.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the patient's consent.

attributes.name: details
attributes.description: Additional details or notes regarding the consent.
